review_candidates.title: Sales Development Representative
review_candidates.description: Companies looking for talent across Southeast Asia still have to choose between doing everything themselves, hiring expensive internal recruiting teams, or paying traditional agencies large success fees. High Five is building a better model. We combine human recruiters, AI agents, and software to help companies find, assess, and hire great talent across borders. Our recruitment subscription gives companies a full-service recruiting team for a flat monthly fee, while our Employer of Record service helps them legally employ and pay people in markets where they do not have their own entity. About the Role You’ll be responsible for starting conversations with companies that could become High Five customers. This is not a role where success means sending thousands of generic emails. Your job is to understand who we should be speaking to, find the right people inside those companies, write messages that actually deserve a response, and consistently turn outbound prospecting into qualified sales meetings. You’ll primarily sell two High Five products: Our recruitment subscription, helping companies hire talent without traditional agency success fees Our Employer of Record service, helping international companies employ and pay people compliantly in markets where they do not have a local entity You’ll work directly with the CEO and have significant ownership over how outbound is executed. Role and Responsibilities Use signals such as hiring activity, international expansion, open roles, new market entry, and company growth to identify companies that are more likely to need High Five Build targeted prospect lists of companies that match High Five’s ideal customer profile across international markets Identify the right decision-makers, including founders, CxOs, Heads of HRs, Talent leaders, and other relevant stakeholders Research prospects before outreach so messages are relevant and accurate Write personalized cold emails, LinkedIn messages, and follow-ups designed to start genuine conversations Run outbound campaigns across email and LinkedIn Test different industries, personas, geographies, offers, and messaging angles to improve conversion Keep prospect and campaign data organized and up to date Track outreach performance and understand where prospects drop out of the funnel Consistently generate qualified sales meetings and build a healthy pipeline every month. The Tools You’ll Use You’ll work with tools such as: LinkedIn Sales Navigator Instantly Apollo Airtable ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or other LLMs/agentic tools Other prospecting and sales tools we adopt as the company grows We care less about whether you have used every exact tool before and more about whether you can learn new tools quickly and use them intelligently. AI should make you better at your job, not replace your judgment. What Success Looks Like Within your first 90 days: You understand High Five’s products, customers, and ideal customer profiles well enough to identify strong prospects independently You can build high-quality prospect lists without needing someone to check every account You are consistently running outbound campaigns across email and LinkedIn Your research and outreach contain very few avoidable mistakes You understand which messages, personas, industries, and markets are converting — and which are not You are generating qualified meetings consistently and are clearly progressing toward your target You are bringing ideas to the CEO about how we can improve outbound rather than simply executing instructions When a campaign underperforms, your instinct is to investigate, experiment, and improve it Qualifications 1–3 years experience doing outbound B2B sales, business development, or sales development Proven experience prospecting through cold email and LinkedIn Experience selling or prospecting to B2B customers outside Indonesia (Singapore, HK, Australia, USA, Canada, UK and more) Excellent written and spoken English Comfortable researching companies, industries, and individual prospects Strong attention to detail — names, companies, job titles, personalization, CRM data, and follow-ups need to be accurate Comfortable working with numbers and understanding basic outbound metrics such as reply rates, meeting rates, conversion rates, and pipeline Able to manage your own workload in a remote environment Comfortable with flexible working hours (early mornings and late nights) when international prospects require it The Kind of Person Who Will Do Well Here You care about results and look for ways to improve your performance without being asked. You consistently follow through. If you commit to doing something, it gets done without constant reminders. You’re highly detail-oriented and take pride in getting the small things right. You’re resilient and persistent — rejection doesn’t discourage you or stop you from following up. When something doesn't work, your first instinct is to understand why and improve it, rather than look for excuses. You ask good questions, challenge assumptions, and actively look for patterns that can make outbound more effective. Where You Might Be Coming From You might currently be: An SDR, BDR or AE at a SaaS or technology company Doing outbound sales for an agency, recruitment company, or professional services business Selling internationally from Indonesia or elsewhere in Southeast Asia Working at a startup where you had to build your own prospect lists rather than being handed perfectly qualified leads Running email and LinkedIn outreach campaigns for international B2B customers Your title matters less than whether you can show us that you know how to create qualified sales conversations.

Beyond the transactional work, you'll coordinate with our regional offices to keep operations aligned, and keep internal teams informed on any changes coming out of MoHRE , the Ministry of Labour, or relevant free zone authorities . When regulations shift, your colleagues should hear it from you first. Day-to-day, you'll handle medical fitness applications, Emirates ID submissions, and petty cash reconciliation with the Finance team on a weekly basis . Account managers across the business will lean on you for answers to UAE labour-related queries — so strong knowledge of local laws isn't optional, it's essential. This role requires someone who can lead independently, manage their own workload without hand-holding, and stay calm when deadlines stack up.

We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000 This individual will report to the Director, Technical Accounting, External Reporting and Consolidations. The Experienced Financial Analyst will play a critical role in all aspects of the consolidation and external report process. This role is pivotal to ensuring the timely and accurate preparation of our quarterly external reporting, Form 10Q/K for filing with the SEC under US GAAP as well as other regulatory filings as needed such as registration statements for GPGI, Inc. (NYSE: GPGI) non-controlling interest owner as well as support Resolute Holdings (NYSE: RHLD) through GPGI Holdings, Husky’s parent. This role provides exposure to GPGI Inc.’s senior and executive levels of management throughout the organizational structure, which allows for a global scope, significant complexity (number of entities, structures and currencies) and the opportunity to work with multiple finance teams such as accounting, tax, treasury and business support. Responsibilities Consolidate analysis to support monthly/quarterly/yearly variance explanations Analyze intercompany transactions and prepare intercompany elimination entries Provide support in the preparation of the 10Q and 10K including preparation of note disclosures, press releases, reporting packages and other publicly available deliverables Participate in the quarterly review and year end external audit Assist with technical accounting research and at times, preparing accounting memos Ensuring that the level of depth and documentation of work performed adheres to SOX requirements Adhoc duties and other projects as required Qualifications University education in Business, Accounting or equivalent CPA designation or pursuing a CPA designation Four (4) to five (5) years’ experience in accounting/finance disciplines Well-versed with office applications (Excel, Outlook, Word) Workiva, Microsoft AX Dynamics (ERP) and OneStream (consolidation system) experience is an asset Experience working in a SOX internal controls, multinational public company and/or a manufacturing environment are assets Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Good understanding of US GAAP as it relates to complex accounting areas such as consolidations, mergers and acquisitions, revenue, stock-based compensation, debt, impairment (goodwill, tangible and intangibles) and internal controls Strong consolidation experience Experience in preparing documents for publicly traded companies Technical accounting memo writing skills and research skills including new accounting standards updates Ability to successfully meet deadlines and objectives in a fast-paced environment i.e. ability to multi-task Ensure that communication is presented clearly, concisely, and timely A proactive individual who is highly motivated, energetic and driven by continuous process improvements Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner. Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
